sahneler.metin: An Amtrak train at over one hundred miles per hour hit locomotives on its track.
It crashed and killed fourteen passengers and two crew.
Conrail locomotives had run onto the main line.
Their crew failed to stop at the signals.
Their cab warning whistle had been muted with duct tape.
Congress later mandated random drug testing for safety-sensitive jobs.

aciklama:
Chase Maryland caused an Amtrak train to hit light locomotives. The cause: locomotives fouling the main line after passing stop signals, with a cab signal whistle taped silent.
